# CoreRail

## About
CoreRail (creativecorerail.com) is Kevin Pedeaux, a New Orleans operator who builds the software and websites his own businesses run on, and builds the same for other small businesses. He operates St. Roch Market (a New Orleans food hall trading since 1875, with 11 independent vendors) and CR Coffee (New Orleans coffee shops), and the software runs in the buildings he opens every morning. Services: operational software (settlements, scheduling, checklists, inventory, booking) built on the Square platform; hand-coded websites with SEO, structured data, and Google Business Profile integration; marketing automation that turns social media posts into website news stories and Google Business Profile posts; replacing subscription software with software the business owns. Data setup is free: clients send their records in any form and Kevin loads them himself.
